entry.title: Intensive blood pressure control protects the heart—with no added kidney failure risk detected
entry.summary: High blood pressure forces the heart to work harder to pump blood. Over time, this extra strain can thicken the heart muscle and narrow the arteries, further complicating cardiovascular health. Even in people with no other health conditions, a 20 mmHg rise in blood pressure doubles the risk of dying from heart disease.

entry.title: A new lipoprotein lipase gene mutation discovered in a family with hypertriglyceridemia
entry.summary: Hypertriglyceridemia (HTG) is a common lipid disorder associated with increased risk of acute pancreatitis and cardiovascular disease (CVD). This study aimed to characterize a pedigree with familial aggregation of HTG and investigate the potential contribution of a novel variant in the lipoprotein lipase (LPL) gene.
